tools.name: check_bill
tools.description: Runs neatly's free check on the user's actual damage bill. Send the bill (screenshot, photo or PDF) and/or the damage photos the host or rental company sent, as https links or base64. Six AI agents check the photos (AI-made or edited, reused, photos of a screen, photo dates) and every charge against the platform's rules and the country's law. Returns the verdict, the amount at stake, the strongest point in full, how many more points the full report has, and a report link for the user. Free, no account. Ask the user before sending their files. If the bill turns out fair the full report unlocks free.

platform.description: Who sent the bill, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Stayz, Hipcamp, Hertz, Sixt, Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Turo, Zipcar, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Camplify, JUCY, Britz, Maui, a direct host

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

bill_type.description: stay for a holiday or vacation rental, car for a rental car or car hire. Worked out from platform if left out

amount.description: Amount being asked for, if known

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. USD or AUD. Defaults to the country's currency

checkout_or_return_date.description: Checkout date for a stay or return date for a car, YYYY-MM-DD, if known

description.description: The host's or company's message and anything the user says happened, in their words. Optional

files.description: At least one bill or one of their damage photos. Roles: bill = the bill or message (up to 3, PDF allowed), theirs = the damage photos they sent (up to 8), mine = the user's own photos from the end of the stay or rental (up to 6), listing = listing or pick-up photos (up to 4). Originals work best: forwarded or screenshotted photos lose their hidden details

url.description: Public https link to the file

data_base64.description: The file as base64, instead of a url. Keep all base64 files in one call under 4 MB in total; use https links for anything bigger

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Gets a neatly report by its link or id. Before the full report is unlocked: the verdict, stamps, the strongest point and how many more points there are. Once unlocked (paid, or free because the bill was fair): every finding, what the bill charged, the evidence to ask for, where to escalate and replies ready to send. Call again after the user pays.

report_url.description: The report link or its id

tools.name: unlock_full_report
tools.description: Starts a one-off payment for the full report and ready-to-send replies (A$29 in Australia, US$19 in the US, tax included, no subscription). Returns a secure Stripe checkout link: give it to the user to open and pay themselves (Apple Pay, Google Pay or card). Never ask for card details. After they pay, call get_report to fetch the full report. Only offer it when the user wants the full report.

report_url.description: The report link or its id
